Contributing to ggmira

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

MiRA’s app in inst/MiRA: change it in MiRA, then sync

inst/MiRA is a copy of MiRA’s web app. Do not edit it here. A fix made only here is lost at the next sync, and the website never gets it.

To change anything in the app (its JavaScript, CSS, index.html or the manual):

  1. Make the change in MiRA, on a branch, and merge it to MiRA’s main.

  2. With MiRA and ggmira checked out side by side, run in MiRA:

    npm run sync:ggmira

    This replaces inst/MiRA and records the MiRA commit in inst/MiRA/MIRA_COMMIT.

  3. Commit inst/MiRA in ggmira, with any R changes that go with it.

If ggmira needs the app to behave differently from the website, MiRA handles that with the URL ggmira opens it with. ?autoload=true means MiRA was opened from R, ?pane=rstudio means RStudio’s Viewer pane, and ?save=true means mira_save().

The mira-bundle check fails a pull request if inst/MiRA is not an unedited sync of a commit on MiRA’s main.
